problem_statement: Enterprise logistics and supply-chain operations suffer from fragmented visibility, slow decision loops, and manual workflows that drive excess miles, wasted fuel, missed OTIF targets and high operating costs. Large shippers, 3PLs and fleet operators (annual freight/WMS spend > $50M) face long, uncertain planning cycles, limited real-time telemetry across assets, brittle integrations between TMS/WMS/ERP, and regulatory/sustainability pressures that require measurable emissions and efficiency improvements. Current point solutions force rip-and-replace choices or create new data silos, leaving operations teams unable to automate prescriptive actions at scale.
solution: An AI-driven, enterprise-grade logistics optimization platform that unifies IoT telemetry, edge computing, predictive ML and prescriptive decisioning into a closed-loop system. Key capabilities: real-time asset visibility (fleet, trailers, pallets), dynamic routing and re-dispatch, predictive ETAs and demand forecasting, digital-twin planning for resiliency, yard automation and AGV/last-mile orchestration, plus native TMS/WMS/ERP APIs. Differentiators: end-to-end platform (software + validated IoT stack), low-latency edge+cloud optimization, enterprise integrations and security, outcome-validated pilots that link optimization actions to percent reductions in miles/fuel and cost-per-delivery.
market_opportunity: TAM: ~$8 trillion annual global logistics & transportation spend (all freight, warehousing, last-mile). SAM: ~$60 billion addressable market for logistics/supply-chain software, fleet management, WMS, predictive analytics and IoT services. SOM (5-year achievable): ~$1.2 billion by focusing on enterprise shippers, 3PLs and large fleet operators in North America and Europe with phased rollouts. Opportunity assumptions include SaaS licensing, recurring connectivity fees for IoT, one-time hardware and professional services with conservative penetration and pricing assumptions.
business_model: Primary monetization is SaaS subscription (per-asset / per-vehicle / per-shipment / per-site tiers) plus recurring connectivity/telemetry fees. Secondary revenue from one-time hardware sales, integration & professional services, transaction/usage fees and optional outcome-based revenue-share for validated cost savings. Unit economics targets: software gross margin 70-90%, blended gross margin 60-70%; average enterprise ACV $200k–$500k; LTV:CAC > 3x; CAC payback < 18 months. Operational KPIs: ARR and ARR growth, NRR (>110–120%), pilot-to-production conversion (target 30–50%), churn (logo & revenue), devices/active telemetry streams, contribution margin per customer.
go_to_market: Pilot-first enterprise motion: target vertical pockets (retail/CPG/grocery, cold-chain, regional fleets) with 90–120 day proof-of-value pilots that validate ROI (miles/fuel reduction, OTIF improvements, cost-per-delivery). Sales model: direct enterprise AEs + SEs, solution architects and deployment teams; embed customer success for expansion and NRR. Partner plays: integrations and co-sell with TMS/WMS vendors, system integrators, 3PL partners, OEMs and IoT hardware vendors; channel partnerships to accelerate regional rollouts. Pricing & packaging: modular tiers (visibility, optimization, planning), per-asset or per-shipment pricing, optional outcomes-based contracts for large deals. GTM metrics: pipeline coverage, average sales cycle (6–12 months enterprise), pilot conversion, average ARR per new customer, and time-to-deploy (target 60–120 days for enterprise pilots).
financials_and_ask: Recommended raise: $8,000,000–$12,000,000 (Late Seed / Series A) to fund 18–24 months runway for scaling GTM, integrations, IoT deployments and product R&D. Valuation benchmark: Seed $10M–$20M (early pilots), Series A $20M–$50M pre-money with $1M+ ARR and reference customers. Planned use of funds (approx.): 40% GTM (sales hires, pipeline generation), 30% product & ML R&D (platform, edge software, model ops), 15% hardware inventory & integration partners, 10% customer success & professional services, 5% general ops/legal. Target milestones by end of runway: $3M–$5M ARR, 15–25 enterprise customers (average ACV $200k–$500k), 10k+ connected assets/active telemetry streams, pilot-to-production conversion >30%, NRR >110–120%, blended gross margin >60%, CAC payback <18 months and LTV:CAC >3x. Key investor metrics to track and report: ARR & growth, NRR/retention, gross & contribution margin, CAC & payback, LTV, ACV & cohort trends, devices connected/monthly active telemetry, pilot conversion rate, time-to-deploy, validated customer ROI (% miles/fuel reduction, OTIF improvement), churn and customer concentration. Ideal investors: logistics-tech VCs, enterprise SaaS funds, IoT/hardware investors and strategic corporate venture partners in shipping/3PL.
